subject: [hw] V41 -> D01: fact for FACTS.md -- a DMA buffer allocated with hw->dma_alloc() is invisible to n2ap_venc_encode() until n2vc_dma_guest_register()
body:
Statement: n2ap_venc_encode()/n2ap_venc_encode_fd() resolve the bitstream and frame handles only through the process-global n2vc_dma registry (n2vc_dma_lookup_handle). A handle returned by n2vc_hw.dma_alloc() directly is not in that registry and the call returns -EINVAL before any IPI message; n2vc_dma_guest_register(h, NULL, handle, pa, bytes, NULL) adds a pa-only entry, n2vc_dma_guest_forget() removes it.

Evidence [V]: gpu/hwcodec/ap/n2vc_dma.c:420-444 (lookup only in the table), ap/n2ap_venc.c:1248-1261 (encode_fd refuses on lookup failure), new regression test ap/test_v41/t_v41.c "vcodecd separate sequence-header job" (669 line area), run: N2TEST V41 PASS 667/667. Concrete instance: daemon/vcodecd.c read_sequence_header() line 523 allocates with hw->dma_alloc() and line 527 hands the handle to n2ap_venc_encode(); the fix is the 4-line registration posted to hw-ip/opus-lead2 just now. daemon/test/fake_vhost.c:606-621 returns -ENOENT/-ENOSYS, which is why the daemon unit tests cannot see it.

Relevance for FACTS.md: integration rule, not a hardware fact: "any buffer the AP hands to an encoder job must be registered in n2vc_dma first; allocation and registration are separate steps." No phone, nothing published.
